name: Top Producer
description: Top Producer is a real-estate CRM for capturing leads, managing contacts, properties and transactions, coordinating tasks and calendars, and sending personalized email, text and MLS follow-up.
agentUseSummary: Top Producer is visible as a provider-partnership and lead-privacy preview. Relay will not use invite-only automation, collect account credentials, ingest leads or access CRM records until Top Producer publishes and approves a scoped, auditable production authorization contract.

capabilities.label: Review a bounded Top Producer integration
capabilities.description: If provider approval is obtained, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted and typed CRM summaries under immutable grants and explicit action policy.

blocked.label: Capture Top Producer credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a user to share a Top Producer login, session, API key, OAuth token or Zapier connection credential.

blocked.label: Access private CRM data
blocked.description: Contacts, leads, notes, activities, communications, calendars, properties, MLS insights, transactions and commissions are unavailable.

blocked.label: Create leads or change records
blocked.description: Relay will not use the invite-only Zapier action, import leads, create contacts or add, update, delete, tag, assign, export or bulk-process CRM records.

blocked.label: Send communications or run follow-up
blocked.description: Email, text, Market Snapshot reports, listing alerts, task plans, AI-written messages and automated follow-up are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Top Producer actions before review
blocked.description: No Top Producer tool is callable until the provider supplies delegated authorization, granular scopes, exact tenant claims, credential lifecycle, limits, audit identifiers and production distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Top Producer partnership and lead-data review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable while Top Producer's public integration path is provider-managed and lacks a product-specific authorization contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Top Producer's current provider-managed lead-integration surface.
No Hermes tools are callable under Top Producer's current provider-managed lead-integration surface.

providerSetup.blocker: Top Producer advertises direct ingestion from 150+ lead providers and documents an invite-only Zapier action that signs a user into a chosen Top Producer account and creates new contact records. Its partner page says the Integration Partner program is coming soon and offers a waitlist. A generic data-processing agreement says public product APIs may use an API key or OAuth, but current public Top Producer materials do not publish product endpoints, scopes, client registration, tenant claims, token issuance, rotation, revocation, limits, webhook security or third-party distribution terms.
providerSetup.nextAction: Join the provider's integration-partner review and request a Top Producer-specific delegated OAuth contract with exact account and user claims, granular read-only scopes, PKCE, refresh rotation and coordinated revocation, typed schemas, rate limits, webhook signatures and replay protection, audit identifiers, lead consent/deletion handling, privacy terms and a staging tenant. Then implement bounded redacted reads before separately approved lead creation.

evidence.supports: Top Producer describes its current CRM as managing contacts, leads, communications, tasks, transactions, MLS insights and automated email and text follow-up.
Top Producer advertises provider-managed integrations with more than 150 online lead sources rather than a self-service public developer platform.
The official Zapier setup uses a special public-invite link, signs the user into a selected Top Producer account and maps source fields into newly created CRM contacts.
Top Producer marks its Integration Partner program as coming soon and directs interested developers, agencies and lead providers to a waitlist.

Top Producer's data-processing agreement states generically that public product APIs may use an API key or OAuth and describes CRM customer personal data and least-privilege controls, without publishing a Top Producer product authorization contract.
